newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Optus says float not dependent on Telstra accord.
newsitem.headline: Optus says float not dependent on Telstra accord.

text.p: Optus Communications Pty Ltd chief executive officer Zygmunt Switkowski said the telecommunications group's planned float would not depend on reaching an infrastructure-sharing agreement with Telstra Corp.
Switkowski said there was no deadline for the float, although the timing would be discussed at the group's next board meeting, scheduled for the end of May.
Optus has said it plans for a calendar 1997 float.
Asked if the Optus float was dependent on Telstra an agreement to share their respective infrastructure for delivering telephony and pay television services, Switkowski replied: "I don't think so."

"I think in terms of preparing ourselves for the content of the prospectus we need to have clarity of our strategy in particular for Optus Vision and clarity of our funding needs and I think we are in a position that is almost there to answer those questions," Switkowski said.
Optus Communications recently took full control of loss-making pay TV group Optus Vision.
